title: Document Processor
description: Serverless accelerator that automates ingestion, validation and extraction over document files, with SFTP synchronization and signature validation.
problem: Document processing is an irregular workload: large batch peaks followed by idle time. Keeping the logic in Functions makes consumption follow real volume instead of a plan sized for the peak.

architecture.caption: Four layers: input, frontend and serverless compute, AI processing and orchestration, and storage with security.

flow: The operator opens the Vite frontend on App Service, which only renders the UI and delegates every operation to the Function App.
The function syncs configuration files from SFTP — customization, naming rules and allowed paths — into Blob Storage.
Before processing, each file's naming is validated against the current rules and its path must be enabled. Anything non-compliant never enters the pipeline.
Document Intelligence applies OCR and returns text, tables and fields with their position; Azure OpenAI interprets the content according to the detected type.
A separate vision deployment handles hard scans and signature validation.
Documents, results and prompts are stored in Blob Storage, so behavior can be tuned without redeploying.

components.name: Azure Functions
components.role: Python v4 with 8 endpoints: SFTP sync, validation, processing and signatures.

components.name: Azure App Service
components.role: Vite frontend: upload and review interface.

components.name: Document Intelligence
components.role: Extraction of text, tables and structured fields.

components.name: Azure OpenAI
components.role: Analysis and classification, with an additional vision deployment.

insight.title: Credentials kept out of the browser
insight.text: The frontend never talks to the AI services: it only knows the Function App URL and key. That keeps the Azure OpenAI and Document Intelligence credentials off the client. It recognizes contracts, schedules, tax ID records, national IDs, promissory notes, sworn statements, AML (SPLAFT) and tax documents.
